Materials: padded black vinyl seat, black steel X frame, rubber end caps

product.name: AmazonBasics Standard Adjustable Padded Piano and Keyboard X-Style Bench
product.description: Standard piano and keyboard X-style bench provides reliable stability and balance Made of durable steel with a sleek black finish; 2-inch foam-padded seat helps ensure sitting comfort 3 position height adjustment (19 to 21 inches) to accommodate different users; 250-pound weight capacity Can be folded flat for compact storage; ideal for home, class, or performance space Measures 12.6 by 16.7 by 19.7 inches (LxWxH); backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
